[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=The Hidden City of Ahdashim | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=413 }} Hidden in northern [[Vabbi]], the '''City of Ahdashim''' served to protect the Princes of the region during the reign of [[Palawa Joko]]. Seas of gold and gems are said to be found there; although the controlling [[djinn]] are not likely to let anyone near it, should they find the way into the city first. ==Getting there== This area is only accessible via the [[Dasha Vestibule (outpost)|Dasha Vestibule mission outpost]] by speaking to the [[Key of Ahdashim]]. The character must have completed either the [[Dasha Vestibule]] mission or the [[Dzagonur Bastion]] mission. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Vabbian Scout]] → with four pillars.) *[[Vabbi Chest]] *[[Altar of Water]] (during [[Gift of the Djinn]]) *[[Altar of Fire]] (during Gift of the Djinn) ==Notes== *Beyond the first chamber (which has [[popup|hidden]] djinn on both sides) where the party starts, this area is divided into three paths: **The central path runs all the way to the northern edge of the map. There are numerous elementals along the way, including several hidden groups. **The western path starts off with some [[Cobalt]] groups in the first chamber. The rest of it is also filled with hidden and patrolling groups of elementals. **The eastern path is actually outside the city proper. As such, it is instead populated by hostile [[plant]]s, [[beast]]s, [[heket]]s, and [[beetles]]. Hidden groups of beetles are found in the paths towards the north. *This area is underground (i.e. does not show up on the [[World Map]]) and so does not contribute to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 231|low = 205|high = 257}} **The elementals in this area (especially the boss groups) are capable of dealing a very large amount of area damage. Always try to spread out before engaging. **Damage reduction skills (or increasing one's [[health]]), especially those that affect the whole [[party]], together with [[health degeneration]] counters will ease the difficulty of this area greatly. **Interrupts, especially AoE ones such as [[Cry of Frustration]] and [[Panic]] will make defeating the [[Roaring Ethers]] much easier preventing the use of their [[Resurrection Signet]]s and large AoE Spikes from [[Energy Surge]]. **The [[Gift of the Djinn]] quest will reduce the total number of creatures that spawn. But do not activate the altars, because this will trigger a lot of Djinn. * Having the quest [[Gift of the Djinn]] in your quest log prevents [[Nicholas the Traveler]] from spawning in the [[Hidden City of Ahdashim]]. As per most quests, you must be in an outpost to abandon it and get Nicholas to spawn as normal. ==Trivia== {{gw2w|The Key of Ahdashim}} *This area and [[Bahdok Caverns]] are the only explorable areas that do not contribute to the Cartographer title track and can be vanquished. {{Explorable areas in Vabbi}} [[Category:Has Lightbringer bounties]] [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[Category:Wayfarer's Reverie landmarks]] [[de:Verborgene Stadt von Ahdashim]]
